name: Uno

variants.name: Stacking draw cards
variants.description: A Draw 2 may be answered with another Draw 2, passing the accumulated penalty on.

variants.name: Jump-in
variants.description: A player holding the identical card may play it out of turn.

variants.name: Sevens and zeros
variants.description: Playing a 7 swaps hands with a chosen player; a 0 rotates all hands in the direction of play.

variants.name: Draw to match
variants.description: When stuck, draw until you can play instead of drawing one.
